obligor_name: Cleveland Clinic Florida (Martin Memorial Medical Center)
obligor_aliases: Martin County Health Facilities Authority obligated entity

moodys.citation_text: Cleveland Clinic Florida (formerly Martin Memorial) rolls into the Cleveland Clinic Health System Obligated Group, which carries Aa2/Stable from Moody's. Bond Buyer noted earlier that 'Cleveland Clinic buyout boosts Florida system's rating' — after merger, Martin Health adopted the Aa2 rating.

sp.citation_text: Inherits Cleveland Clinic Health System AA/Stable as part of obligated group.

moodys.citation_text: Moody's affirmed Cleveland Clinic Health System Obligated Group's (OH) Aa2; stable outlook — Martin County HFA bonds for Cleveland Clinic Florida inherit obligated-group rating.

outcome_class_rationale: Cleveland Clinic Florida (Martin Memorial) ratings are subsumed into Cleveland Clinic Health System Obligated Group ratings, which were affirmed Aa2/AA with stable outlook throughout the window.
